referenceFunction.generalComment: The multi-output-process "anode slime generation, primary copper production" delivers the co-products "anode slime, silver and tellurium containing, primary copper production" and "cathode, copper, primary copper production". The product "cathode, …" is an intermediary in the production of refined copper and is not to be used by the LCA practitioner. The flow "anode slime, …" is a by-product of this process that receives part of the burdens allocated.; UUID: f3cb3170-e687-3885-9f62-f2ca7a005bf8
